turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let me know if I am too quiet.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: You are fine, thank you for asking.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What brings you to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I came because of my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel it in your left arm or in your jaw?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nowhere else.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How would you describe what you feel in your chest?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It came on slowly last night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything ease the pain when it is there?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took an antacid and it did not do anything.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only when I hurry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel winded along with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No trouble breathing at all.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you drenched or clammy during the episodes?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint or dizzy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let me ask about risk factors: tobacco, blood pressure, diabetes, cholesterol.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have high blood pressure, and I have high cholesterol. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Has a parent or sibling had a heart attack?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother had bypass surgery.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you had any procedure on your heart before?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have never had any.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What are you taking at home for your health?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Lisinopril and Atorvastatin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: To finish, here is the plan. First, come back to this clinic in one week. Second, call 911 if the pain gets worse or does not stop. To be sure I was clear, what will you do next?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will come back here in a week and call 911 if the pain gets worse or will not stop.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any other questions before you go?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing else, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: All right, we are done. Take care of yourself.
